discrepancy.observation: a-p4-group-original.hwpx stores parent container at (500, 500) HWPUNIT, rect child at offset=(0, 0), and ellipse child at offset=(6500, 800) / pos=(6500, 800), but child renderingInfo matrices are identity. Baseline SVG placed rect at (6.6667, 6.6667) px and ellipse at cx=41.3333, cy=34 px (same origin as rect).
rootCause: HWPX serializer write_rendering_info (src/serializer/hwpx/shape.rs) ignored ShapeComponentAttr.render_tx/ty/sx/sy/b/c whenever raw_rendering was empty (as cleared by group_shapes_native), emitting identity transMatrix despite model render_tx=6500, render_ty=800.

HWPX container parser parse_container_body (src/parser/hwpx/section.rs) left render_tx=0, render_ty=0 when renderingInfo contained exact identity matrices and nonzero hp:offset, causing shape_layout.rs to collapse the ellipse onto the group origin.

geometryContract.parentLocal: Top-level container (groupLevel=0) positions on page from CommonObjAttr horzOffset/vertOffset (base_x/base_y -> group_origin). Flat children live in container-local HWPUNIT coordinates.
geometryContract.childTransform: When renderingInfo is non-identity or non-empty non-identity raw_rendering, composed render_sx/b/tx/c/sy/ty is authoritative (no double-application of offset_x/offset_y). When a flat HWPX container child has exact identity rendering matrices, zero rotation, no flip, and nonzero hp:offset, render_tx/render_ty inherit offset_x/offset_y in memory without mutating raw_rendering or offset.
geometryContract.serialization: write_rendering_info preserves decoded raw_rendering verbatim when present (no-op save equality); when raw_rendering is empty, explicit render_tx/ty/sx/sy/b/c matrices are emitted instead of falling back to identity.
